Terms of use

The terms under which FormFit is provided, and its limits.

Using this site

FormFit is provided free of charge for personal use. You may use it to prepare images for examination and application forms. You may not attempt to disrupt the service, run automated bulk requests against it, or republish its content as your own.

Accuracy of the sizes we list

The dimensions and file size limits shown on this site are compiled from published examination notifications and are offered as a convenience. Examination bodies revise their requirements between cycles and occasionally between papers in the same cycle.

The official notification for your examination is the only authoritative source. Always check the numbers there before you upload. We accept no responsibility for an application rejected because a specification changed after we published it.

No warranty

The tool is provided as is. We do not guarantee that a file produced here will be accepted by any particular portal, because acceptance depends on that portal's own rules and behaviour, which are outside our control.

To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss arising from use of this site, including a missed application deadline.

This site is supported by advertising. Advertisements are supplied by third parties and their presence does not constitute an endorsement by us of the advertiser, its products, or its services. Any dealing you have with an advertiser is between you and them.

The text, design and code of this site belong to us. Images you process remain entirely yours, and since they never reach our servers we could make no claim over them even if we wished to.
